map.：例：a=5m、b=3m → A=π×15=47.1239 m²。若 a=10m: : Example: a=5m, b=3m -> A=π×15=47.1239 m^2. If a=10m, b=6m (both semi-axes doubled) -> A=π×60=188.4956 m^2 (4x the former, since both semi-axes scale linearly).

map.椭圆面积为何没有单独的“半轴平方”？: Why does ellipse area have no separate "semi-axis squared"?
map.圆的面积是 πr²，椭圆可看作圆在两个方向分别拉伸 a/r 与 b/r 倍，面积: Circle area is πr^2; an ellipse is a circle stretched by a/r and b/r in two directions, area scaled by ab/r^2; set r=1 to get πab. It equals multiplying the two semi-axes then by π.
